blockingIssues.description: crates/ciri-app/src/grid/sync.rs trims scrollback with pop_front() after rebasing grapheme_map to absolute indices, but never renormalizes or drops those grapheme_map entries. Once max_scrollback is exceeded, preserved grapheme metadata can shift onto the wrong visible rows after later full-sync handling.

crates/ciri-layout/src/workspace.rs lets active_pane_id() fall back when active_column_idx is stale, but target_offset_for_active_with_strategy() still returns 0.0 when that same stale index is out of range. Cleanup/focus-restoration flows can therefore leave highlighting and viewport targeting disagreeing about the active column.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify in runtime-crate-reviewer guidance that a review feature may legitimately conclude with no production bug found and regression coverage only, rather than forcing an implementation change.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: review-ciri-client passed review with a test-only commit guarding already-correct CLI help-path behavior, and its reviewer flagged that the current skill wording implies every review must first prove and fix a bug.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Align baseline validation expectations between worker-base / review skills and .factory/services.yaml so workers know exactly which pre-review validators are mandatory before starting crate-local investigation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: review-ciri-input reported a procedure deviation because transcript behavior and handoff expectations differed on whether only the manifest's test command or broader baseline validation was required up front.
